english.note: Use this when an attempted helpful action instead creates extra trouble or becomes more hindrance than help.

examples.english: You tried to help me tidy the room, but it was counterproductive and made the room even messier.
examples.traditional: 你想幫我執房，點知幫倒忙，搞到間房更加亂。
